title: Bus Reservation And Ticketing System
summary: Java-based console application simulating bus ticket reservation and billing. Allows login, ticket booking, passenger management, and billing operations.
impact: Main menu for destination, passenger, billing, view, and exit. Handles seat availability, discounts for PWD, students, senior citizens. Prints passenger details, fare, and handles payment and change.

title: Facial Emotion Detection
summary: Detects facial emotions using machine learning models (CNN, SVM, Decision Tree, Random Forest). Features extraction, preprocessing, and performance comparison across multiple datasets.
impact: Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) for applications in healthcare, e-learning, retail, surveillance, and entertainment. Training accuracy up to ~99.8%, ICML dataset ~86.1%.
bullets: Models: CNN, SVM, Random Forest, Decision Tree
Performance: Training accuracy up to ~99.8%, ICML dataset ~86.1%

title: Real Estate Price Prediction
summary: Predicts house prices using supervised regression models. Compares performance using R2 and MSE.
impact: Models: Linear Regression, KNN, Decision Tree, Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting. Requirements: Python 3.9+, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn, scikit-learn. Usage: Run notebook with kc_house_data.csv.

title: Video RAG Retrieval Project
summary: Implements a Video Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. Enables semantic search over videos by converting scenes and frames into embeddings for nearest-neighbor lookups.
impact: Features: Frame extraction, scene description, text/image embeddings, FAISS vector store, semantic retrieval. Example usage: Index scenes, run text queries, retrieve relevant video segments. Installation: Python, pip, requirements.txt. Notes: Extensible for advanced scene detection and production vector databases.

title: Raccoon Network Analysis
summary: Analyzes the spread of rabies in raccoons using network centrality measures to generalize to human rabies spread.
impact: Network centrality analysis for epidemiology. Jupyter Notebook implementation.

title: Tableau Data Visualization
summary: Data visualization on hotel booking dataset using Tableau. Multiple worksheets and dashboard actions.
impact: Hotel booking dataset analysis. Multiple Tableau worksheets and dashboards.
